config.user_description: There's a .claude/skills/do-semi-automatic/SKILL.md. It needs manual approval of the plan/PRD. Make a do-fully-automatic skill that does not need such an approval: If the requirements in the ticket are clear, it creates a plan and implements it. But if the requirements are not clear, it falls back to 'Blocked' with a comment. And if there's an unsolvable problem during implementation, the ticket also moves back to blocked, just like do-semi-automatic does.
